mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 7.0% signal weak labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and industrial production indicate robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth > 0.5% in 1 month AND INDPRO growth > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO show growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Pre-hike monetary policy environments defined by rising federal funds rates and strong industrial production trigger market anticipation of tighter policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 1 month AND INDPRO > 100
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the pre-hike trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth, as measured by PAYEMS, indicates a healthy labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation above 2.5% as measured by CPIAUCSL signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising real interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer credit (RSAFS) combined with stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS change <= 0.1%) indicates strong consumer spending and accommodative finance, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.5% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS change <= 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% and FEDFUNDS change is <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle economic expansions, characterized by strong GDP growth and low unemployment, lead to overvaluation and increased risk of policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the late-cycle trigger condition.
